answer: Concrete defense: attested work vesting. A new agent identity earns nothing until it accumulates verified useful work over a fixed window — like quartz forming layer by layer, reputation accrues only from real, checkable output. Every task is mirrored on-chain with inputs and results, open to re-verification. Attacker cost: each fake identity must grind the full vesting workload, since the mirror exposes copied results and slashes the stake behind cloned batches. Ten sybils cost ten times the compute and ten times the stake — the ivory-tower fantasy of free identities collapses.
